# UDreamTextPaintLibrary

<!-- Generated by the DreamGUIReferenceDocs commandlet from reflection. Edit the header, not this page. -->

Inherits from `UBlueprintFunctionLibrary`.

Declared in `Public/Core/Text/DreamTextPaintLibrary.h`.

Tweens that move a text's paints (FDreamTextPaint) without repainting it: each drives one of UDreamText's paint
animation setters, which write one pixel of the text's paint table a step -- no repaint, no layout. They pause with
the game and follow its time dilation as the text's other tweens do (UDreamVisual::ColorTo), and end with the text.

## Functions

| Function | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `UDreamTweener* PaintAngleTo(UDreamText* Text, float To, float Duration, float Delay, EDreamTweenEase Ease)` | callable | Turn every paint of the text (UDreamText::SetPaintAngleOffset) from its angle offset now to To, in degrees. |
| `UDreamTweener* PaintPhaseTo(UDreamText* Text, EDreamTextPaintLayer Layer, float To, float Duration, float Delay, EDreamTweenEase Ease)` | callable | Move one paint's phase (UDreamText::SetFacePaintPhase and its siblings) from where it is to To: its gradient slides along its line, 1 being one whole gradient. Null when there is no text, or no tween manager to run it. |
| `UDreamTweener* PlayShimmer(UDreamText* Text, float Duration, float Delay, int32 Loops)` | callable | Sweep the overlay paint across the text: its phase from -1 to 1 at an even speed, Duration seconds a pass, starting again at -1 after each, Loops passes (-1: until stopped, or until the text goes). The look is the overlay's: a band that is transparent at both ends -- linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 40%, white 50%, transparent 60%) -- with OverlayBlend Add, is a shimmer. The phase stays at -1 during the delay, which keeps such a band off the text. |
